sources.title: Welcome to Rikai! — Rikai documentation
sources.snippet: Welcome to Rikai! Rikai is a framework specifically designed for AI workflows focused around large scale unstructured datasets (e.g., images, videos, sensor data (future), text (future), and more). Through every stage of the AI modeling workflow, Rikai strives to offer a great developer experience when working with real-world AI datasets.
